Alex: Quick handoff — wrapping my shift. us-west-gpu at ~78% over last hour, 3 customers with burst spikes. Pre-warm window scheduled 23:00 UTC. Leaving queue notes below.
Maria: I can cover 22:30-02:00 UTC if you need a swap. Do we have burst credits left for cust-129?
Alex: Thanks — would appreciate cover. cust-129 currently at 4.2k concurrent tokens/min; they blew past steady-state. We have 2 remaining burst windows today.
Josh: Can someone paste the command to check pool headroom? need to glance before my deployment.
Alex: run:
```
redwoodctl pool status --pool us-west-gpu --json | jq '.utilization, .burst_remaining'
```
Here's last-run snippet:
`utilization: 0.78, burst_remaining: 2`
Maria: ok. If load stays >85% for 10m we should trigger pre-warm to add one n1-standard node (auto-scaler scheduled). I'll monitor.
autoscaler-bot: Auto-scaler scheduled job for us-west-gpu at 23:00 UTC (expected +1 node if threshold hit).
Kevin: FYI scheduled infra rollout in us-west at 01:00 UTC — not rolling compute, just control plane. Shouldn't affect runtime but watch for scheduling delays.
Maria: noted. I'll hold off manual pool changes unless we hit 90%+ sustained.
Alex: leaving runbook pointer:
https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/gpu-capacity-check
Handoff complete — ping me if anything weird. :wave:
Maria: Thanks — taking watch. I'll post update if I bump burst or request swap. :thumbsup:
